q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me work through this systematically.

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-16. NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings call is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026. That's **10 days away**. The forward guidance will be announced at that earnings release.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided explicit forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 in their Q1 earnings release on May 20, 2026:
- **Guidance: $91.0 billion ± 2%**
- This translates to a range of $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion

The current research clearly states this guidance, sourced from NVIDIA's official investor relations, the SEC filing, and CNBC reporting. Since we are now only 10 days before the earnings announcement, the company's actual Q2 results are largely finalized, and the "forward guidance" in the earnings release typically refers to Q3 expectations (the next quarter).

However, the question asks specifically about "forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release." This is ambiguous—it could mean:
1. Q2 FY2027 revenue guidance (already known: ~$91B)
2. Forward guidance given during Q2 earnings (guidance for Q3 FY2027)

Given the phrasing "in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release," I interpret this as asking what forward-looking guidance NVIDIA will provide when they announce Q2 results. Typically, companies provide guidance for the next quarter.

The most likely scenario: NVIDIA will maintain or slightly adjust their May guidance of $91B for Q2, and provide new guidance for Q3 FY2027.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Weaker than expected demand due to macro headwinds
- Geopolitical tensions affecting China revenue (already excluded from current guidance)
- Supply chain constraints
- Competitive pressures emerging
- Conservative management stance given market uncertainty
- Any major customer cancellations or delays

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Better than expected AI/data center demand
- Stronger than anticipated customer bookings
- Easing of China-related export restrictions (though currently assumed at zero)
- Gaming and automotive segments outperforming
- Management confidence in sustained demand trajectory
- Upside surprises in hopper/blackwell adoption rates

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides explicit forward guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which equals:
- Lower bound: $89.18 billion
- Upper bound: $92.82 billion

This is not a forecast—this is NVIDIA's official May 2026 guidance for Q2 FY2027, already public. With only 10 days until the earnings call, actual Q2 results are essentially locked in, and they typically fall very close to or within guidance ranges.

Given:
- The company's May guidance of $91B ± 2%
- Only 10 days remain, meaning most of Q2 is already history
- NVIDIA's track record of meeting/beating guidance
- No major negative developments reported in the research

The most likely forward guidance figure will cluster tightly around $91.0 billion, likely in the $89.5B to $92.5B range, with an expected value right at the midpoint of their stated guidance.

**My reasoning**: NVIDIA's stated May guidance puts the expected Q2 result at $91.0B. With 10 days left and most of the quarter complete, there's minimal room for surprise. The range provided (99.5B to 115.5B) extends well above guidance, suggesting either significant upside potential or this question may be asking about subsequent quarters. However, based on the research and stated guidance, I'll center my estimate on the $91B guidance with modest upside potential.

q_45367.research_text: NVIDIA announced record revenue for Q1 FY2207 of \$81.6 billion, up 85% year-over-year, on May 20, 2026 [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's outlook predicts revenue of \$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). Analysts widely expect NVIDIA's Q2 2027 revenue to be around this \$91 billion mark [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report). The company is scheduled to host a conference call to discuss its Q2 FY2027 financial results on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).
